avoidExamples: The best tray ever made!!! Buy now before it is gone!!!
evaluationCriteria: Names one concrete cooking use for the product.
Keeps a calm, practical tone without hype words.
Ends with a single low-pressure next step.
goodExamples: Preheat the tray for ten minutes before the roots go in; the edges caramelise instead of steaming. Save this for Sunday.

avoidExamples: This pack is perfect for every trail and every weather. Totally unbeatable!
evaluationCriteria: Grounds the post in one specific trail situation.
Gives a practical gear detail a walker can check.
Avoids absolute claims about safety or weather.
goodExamples: On a wet woodland loop, the side pocket keeps the map dry and reachable without stopping. Check yours before Saturday.

avoidExamples: Huge sale on notebooks, everything must go today, act fast!
evaluationCriteria: Describes one small writing habit the product supports.
goodExamples: Two lines each morning: what you noticed, what you will try. The dotted pages keep the habit small.
